description: SEC EDGAR full-text search: 10-K annual reports (or another form) whose text contains a phrase such as 'climate risk' or 'scope 1 emissions'. Returns the total hit count and the latest matching filings (company, CIK, form, file date). Shows which companies mention the phrase; it does not extract emission numbers. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many filings to return, 1 to 10 (default 5)

q.description: Phrase to search for, 2 to 80 characters (default: climate risk)
